$comment: Where the first supported provider's name may appear. Everything else uses neutral words (ADR 0009). Add an entry only with a reason, and keep it as narrow as possible: a token beats a file, and a file beats a folder.

files.packages/identity-keycloak/src/keycloak-: The one source file that knows the provider's admin API: its URL layout and raw response shapes.
files.packages/identity-keycloak/README.md: Documents the adapter for that provider.
files.packages/identity-keycloak/test/unit/key: Tests the exact admin API calls that keycloak-api.ts makes.
files.docs/keycloak-setup.md: The setup guide for the first supported provider.
files.docs/adr/**: Architecture decision records: history, and the naming rule itself.
files.docker-compose.yml: Local development services, including the provider.
files.apps/api/prisma/migrations/**: Applied migrations are history and are never edited. Older ones use the old column names.
files.apps/api/test/integration/database-migra: Builds rows in the old column layout to prove the migrations keep data.
files.apps/desktop/src/main/store/legacy-setti: Reads the old saved-settings shape (server URL plus realm) and converts it.

tokens.createKeycloakIdentityProvider: The adapter's factory function and its index export.
tokens.identity-keycloak: The adapter package: its folder, its name and references to either.
tokens.keycloak-api: The adapter's raw API file, as a file name or import path.
tokens.keycloak-setup.md: Links to the provider setup guide.

apps/api/src/config/index.ts.'keycloak': The provider ID that IDENTITY_PROVIDER accepts and defaults to.

apps/api/src/infra/identity.ts.'keycloak': Picks the adapter for that provider ID.

apps/api/test/helpers/harness.ts.'keycloak': The provider ID in the test configuration.

apps/api/test/unit/identity.factory.test.'keycloak': The provider ID in the test configuration.
apps/api/test/unit/identity.factory.test.\"keycloak\": The provider ID in the expected error message.
